Rest up, legend. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-4 vs Real Zurich FC | You: 7.2 (9th worst match performance)
push.body:
A 7.2, PhogsToffees. It's okay to be frustrated. It's not okay to stay frustrated.

DID WELL
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. You made that keeper earn his paycheck.
+ 4 goals conceded nudged it up +0.1. Every inch.

WORK ON
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Start here: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket. Trust me on that one.
- 70% passing (16 of 23). Think about this: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
- 0.6 under your usual. That's a dip, not a trend. Promise.
- Shots: 2. Mid-pack today, 3+ tomorrow.
- Key passes: 0. The next level is 2+.

Skills corner: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide.

Lasso-ism of the day: You miss every pass you don't make, and some you do. Make 'em anyway.

We'll fix it together. - Coach Lasso
